A local SELinux file context rule. Conn3x relabels the files it covers after every change.

```hcl
step "example" {
  selinux_fcontext {
    setype = "..."
    target = "..."
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `on_remove` | string | No | "forget" (default) keeps the rule, "delete" removes it and relabels. |
| `setype` | string | Yes | SELinux type, such as httpd_sys_content_t. |
| `target` | string | Yes | Path expression, such as /srv/www(/.*)?. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_selinux_fcontext.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether the host has the rule. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_selinux_fcontext` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
